title: Evaluation of Three Pulp Vitality Tests
official: Evaluation of Three Pulp Vitality Tests
summary: The objectives of this study are to determine the sensitivity, specificity, positive predictive value, negative predictive value, and accuracy of laser Doppler flowmetry in determining the vitality of teeth and comparing with those of electric pulp testing and cold testing.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Criteria for inclusion in the study will be that the individual has teeth that require endodontic treatment and patient is willing to undergo two additional vitality tests which will take about 20 minutes of additional time.

Exclusion Criteria:

* No group of special subjects or vulnerable population is being targeted in this study.
